title.zh: 在奎松市第二区Batasan Hills描笼涯设立Batasan Hills国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Batasan Hills, Second District of Quezon City, to Be Known as Batasan Hills National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Batasan Hills, Second District of Quezon City, to Be Known as Batasan Hills National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_7987_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: A national high school to be known as Batasan Hills National High School in the second district of Quezon City is hereby established and shall be under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
